name: Camping Stigger Innsbruck - Völs
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Stigger Innsbruck - Völs is located on the western outskirts of Innsbruck, close to Völs. The grounds provide pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents, along with direct access to the scenic Inn Cycle Path. Central Innsbruck is reachable within minutes. Bounded by meadows and a clear stream, the site features a convenience shop, modern sanitary facilities, and a dedicated barbecue area.
